chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from some of our companions, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “They desire to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths.” He said: “They desire to extinguish the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام with their mouths.” I said: “And Allah will complete His light?” He said: “And Allah will complete the Imamate,” due to His saying, Mighty and Majestic: “Those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and the light which We sent down” — so the light is the Imam.

I said: “He it is Who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth.” He said: “He is the One Who commanded His Messenger with the wilayah of his legatee, and the wilayah is the religion of truth.” I said: “That He may make it prevail over all religion?” He said: “He will make it prevail over all religions at the rise of al-Qāʾim.”

He said: “Allah says: ‘And Allah will complete His light’ — the wilayah of al-Qāʾim — ‘though the disbelievers dislike’ the wilayah of ʿAlī.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes. As for this wording, it is revelation; and as for what is besides it, it is interpretation.”

I said: “That is because they believed, then disbelieved.” He said: “Allah, Blessed and Exalted, named those who did not follow His Messenger concerning the wilayah of his legatee as hypocrites, and He made the one who denies the Imamate of his legatee like one who denies Muḥammad. And He sent down Qurʾan regarding that, saying: ‘O Muḥammad, when the hypocrites come to you’ with the wilayah of your legatee, ‘they say: We testify that you are surely the Messenger of Allah, and Allah knows that you are surely His Messenger, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites,’ regarding the wilayah of ʿAlī, ‘are surely liars. They took their oaths as a shield, so they turned away from the way of Allah’ — and the way is the legatee — ‘surely evil is what they were doing. That is because they believed in your messengership and disbelieved in the wilayah of your legatee, so Allah sealed their hearts, thus they do not understand.’”

I said: “What is the meaning of ‘they do not understand’?” He said: “He says: ‘They do not comprehend your prophethood.’” I said: “And when it is said to them: Come, the Messenger of Allah will seek forgiveness for you?” He said: “And when it is said to them: Return to the wilayah of ʿAlī, the Prophet will seek forgiveness for your sins, they twist their heads.” Allah said: “And you see them turning away from the wilayah of ʿAlī while they are arrogant toward it.”

Then the statement turned from Allah by His knowledge of them, and He said: “It is the same for them whether you seek forgiveness for them or do not seek forgiveness for them; Allah will never forgive them. Surely Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people,” meaning: those who are unjust to your legatee.

I said: “Is one who walks fallen upon his face better guided, or one who walks upright upon a straight path?” He said: “Allah has struck the likeness of one who turned away from the wilayah of ʿAlī as one who walks on his face, not guided in his affair; and He made the one who follows him upright upon a straight path. And the straight path is Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.”

He said: I said: “His saying: ‘Indeed, it is surely the word of a noble messenger.’” He said: “Meaning Jibrāʾīl from Allah concerning the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام.” I said: “‘And it is not the word of a poet; little is it that you believe.’” He said: “They said that Muḥammad is a liar against his Lord, and Allah did not command him with this regarding ʿAlī. So Allah sent down Qurʾan about that, and said: ‘Indeed, the wilayah of ʿAlī is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds. And if Muḥammad had fabricated against Us some statements, We would have seized him by the right hand, then We would have cut from him the aorta.’”

Then the discourse turned, and He said: “Indeed, the wilayah of ʿAlī is surely a reminder for the Godwary, for the worlds; and We certainly know that among you are deniers. And indeed ʿAlī is surely a regret for the disbelievers. And indeed his wilayah is surely the truth of certainty. So glorify, O Muḥammad, the Name of your Lord, the Magnificent,” meaning: thank your Magnificent Lord Who gave you this grace.

I said: “His saying: ‘When we heard the guidance, we believed in it.’” He said: “The guidance is the wilayah. We believed in our master. So whoever believes in the wilayah of his master shall fear neither diminution nor oppression.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “No, interpretation.”

I said: “His saying: ‘I do not possess for you harm nor right guidance.’” He said: “The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله called the people to the wilayah of ʿAlī, so Quraysh gathered before him and said: ‘O Muḥammad, excuse us from this.’ The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to them: ‘This belongs to Allah, not to me.’ So they accused him and left his presence.”

So Allah sent down: “Say: I do not possess for you harm nor right guidance. Say: No one can protect me from Allah, if I disobey Him, and I shall never find besides Him any refuge — except a conveyance from Allah and His messages regarding ʿAlī.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes.” Then he said by way of emphasis: “And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger regarding the wilayah of ʿAlī — for him shall be the Fire of Hell, abiding therein forever.”
I said: “Until when they see what they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number?” He said: “By that is meant al-Qāʾim and his supporters.”

I said: “‘And be patient over what they say.’” He said: “What they say about you. ‘And forsake them with a gracious forsaking. And leave Me, O Muḥammad, with the deniers of your legatee, possessors of ease, and grant them a little respite.’” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes.”

I said: “‘So that those who were given the Book may attain certainty.’” He said: “That they become certain that Allah, His Messenger, and his legatee are true.” I said: “‘And those who believe may increase in faith.’” He said: “And they increase in faith through the wilayah of the legatee.” I said: “‘And those who were given the Book and the believers may not doubt.’” He said: “Regarding the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام.” I said: “What is this doubt?” He said: “By that are meant the People of the Book and the believers whom Allah mentioned; thus He said: ‘And they do not doubt concerning the wilayah.’”

I said: “‘And it is nothing but a reminder to mankind.’” He said: “Yes — the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام.” I said: “‘Indeed it is surely one of the greatest matters.’” He said: “The wilayah.” I said: “‘For whoever among you wishes to go forward or stay behind.’” He said: “Whoever goes forward to our wilayah is held back from Saqar, and whoever lags behind from us goes forward to Saqar — except the people of the right hand.” He said: “They, by Allah, are our Shiʿah.”

I said: “‘We were not among those who prayed.’” He said: “Meaning: we did not take as wali the legatee of Muḥammad and the legatees after him, nor did they send salat upon them.” I said: “‘So what is wrong with them that they turn away from the reminder?’” He said: “Turning away from the wilayah.” I said: “‘No indeed, it is surely a reminder.’” He said: “The wilayah.”
I said: “His saying: ‘They fulfill vows.’” He said: “They fulfill for Allah the vow that He took from them in the covenant concerning our wilayah.”

I said: “‘Indeed We have sent down to you the Qurʾan, a sending down.’” He said: “With the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام, a sending down.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes; that is interpretation.” I said: “‘Indeed this is a reminder.’” He said: “The wilayah.” I said: “‘He admits whom He wills into His mercy.’” He said: “Into our wilayah.” Then he said: “‘And for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.’ Do you not see that Allah says: ‘They did not wrong Us, but rather they were wronging themselves’?”

He said: “Allah is too mighty and too exalted to wrong anyone or to ascribe oppression to Himself. But Allah has joined us to Himself, so He made wronging us to be wronging Him, and our wilayah to be His wilayah. Then He sent down Qurʾan regarding that upon His Prophet, and said: ‘And We did not wrong them, but they were wronging themselves.’” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes.”

I said: “‘Woe that Day to the deniers.’” He said: “Meaning: Woe to the deniers, O Muḥammad, of what I revealed to you concerning the wilayah of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. ‘Did We not destroy the former ones? Then We made the later ones follow them.’” He said: “The former ones are those who denied the messengers regarding obedience to the legatees. ‘Thus do We deal with the guilty’ — meaning those who acted criminally toward the family of Muḥammad and did concerning his legatee what they did.”
I said: “‘Indeed the Godwary...’” He said: “By Allah, it is us and our Shiʿah. None besides us is upon the creed of Ibrāhīm, and the rest of the people are free of it.”

I said: “‘The Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in ranks; they do not speak...’ — the verse.” He said: “By Allah, we are those permitted for them on the Day of Resurrection, and those who speak rightly.” I said: “What will you say when you speak?” He said: “We glorify our Lord, send salat upon our Prophet, and intercede for our Shiʿah, and our Lord will not reject us.”
I said: “‘No indeed, the record of the wicked is surely in Sijjīn.’” He said: “They are those who acted wickedly regarding the right of the Imams and transgressed against them.”
I said: “‘Then it will be said: This is that which you used to deny.’” He said: “Meaning Amīr al-Muʾminīn.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.الصِّرَاطُ الْمُسْتَقِيمُ: the straight path, interpreted here as Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام
key_terms.النُّورُ: the divine light interpreted here as the Imam
key_terms.الْإِمَامَةُ: the divinely ordained leadership of the Imam
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: the awaited Imam whose rise will manifest the truth over all religions
key_terms.تَأْوِيلٌ: interpretive meaning or inner referent of the verse
key_terms.شِيعَتُنَا: the followers and loyal adherents of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.وَلَايَةُ: divinely mandated authority and loyalty, here referring especially to the authority of ʿAlī عليه السلام and the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith from al-Kāfī interpret Qurʾanic verses about light, guidance, and religion in relation to the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents an extended Qurʾanic commentary in which numerous verses are interpreted in relation to the wilayah and Imamate of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام and the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It emphasizes that divine guidance, true religion, salvation, and ultimate vindication are bound to loyalty to the Imam, while rejection of wilayah is portrayed as hypocrisy, deviation, and a cause of punishment.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from some of our companions, from Ibn Mahboub, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Maazyasws (7th Imamasws), said, ‘I asked Himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [61:8] They are intending to extinguish the Light of Allah with their mouths. Heasws said: ‘They are intending to extinguish the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineenasws with their mouths (talking against it)’. I said, ‘but Allah will Complete His light’. Heasws said: ‘And Allahazwj will Complete the Imamat due to Hisazwj Words, the Mighty and Majestic [64:8] Therefore believe in Allah and His Rasool and the Light which We have Sent down. So the Light, it is the Imamasws’. I said, ‘[61:9] He it is Who sent His Messenger with the Guidance and the true Religion’. Heasws said: ‘Heazwj is Who Commanded Hisazwj Rasoolsaww with the Wilayah of hissaww successorasws, and the Wilayah - is the true Religion’. I said, ‘That He may make it overcome the religions, all of them’. Heasws said: ‘Overcome upon the entirety of the Religions during the rising of Al-Qaimasws’. Heasws said: ‘Allahazwj is Saying: but Allah will Complete His light, the Wilayah of Al-Qaimasws though the unbelievers may be averse to it, the Wilayah of Aliasws’. I said, ‘This is Revelation?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes. As for this word, so it is Revelation, and as for other than it, so it is explanation’. I said, ‘[63:3] That is because they believe, then disbelieve. Heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Blessed and High has Named the one who does not follow Hisazwj Rasoolsaww regarding the Wilayah of hissaww successorasws, as a hypocrite, and Made the one who rejects the Imamate of hissaww successorasws like the one who rejects Muhammadsaww, and the Quran was Revealed with that. So Heazwj Said: “O Muhammadsaww! [63:1] When the hypocrites come to you, with the Wilayah of Aliasws they say: We testify that you are Rasool-Allah; and Allah knows that you are His Rasool, and Allah Testifies that the hypocrites with the Wilayah of Aliasws, are liars [63:2] They are making their oaths to be a cover, and thus turning away from Allah's Way, and Allahazwj Way, it is the successorasws. surely evil is that which they are doing. That is because they are believing in yoursaww Messenger-ship and are disbelieving in the Wilayah of yoursaww successorasws. Thus a seal is set upon their hearts so that they do not understand. I said, ‘What is the meaning of ‘they do not understand’?’ Heasws said: ‘Heazwj is Saying: “They do not understand yoursaww Prophet-hood”’. I said, ‘[63:5] And when it is said to them: Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you. Heasws said: ‘And when it is said to them: ‘Return to the Wilayah of Aliasws, the Prophetsaww would seek Forgiveness for you all for your sins they turn back their heads. Allahazwj Said: “And you will see them blocking from the Wilayah of Aliasws, while they are big with arrogance over it. Then the Words of Allahazwj Turned by hisas understanding with them, so Heazwj Said [63:6] It is Alike to them whether you seek Forgiveness for them or do not seek Forgiveness for them; Allah will never Forgive them; surely Allah does not guide the transgressing people. Heazwj is Saying: “The ones unjust to yoursaww successorasws”’. I said, ‘[67:22] Is the one who goes prone upon his face better guided or he who walks upright upon a Straight Path?’ Heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Struck an example of the one who is guided away from the Wilayah of Aliasws to be like the one who falls prone upon his face, having no guidance for his affairs, whereas (Allahazwj) Made the one who follows himasws as walking upright upon the Straight Path, and the Straight Path is Amir Al-Momineenasws’. He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘[69:40] Most surely, it is the Word of an Honoured Messenger’. Heasws said: ‘It Means Jibraeelas, from Allahazwj, regarding the Wilayah of Aliasws’. I said, ‘[69:41] And it is not the word of a poet; little it is that you believe’. Heasws said: ‘They are saying that Muhammadsaww is a liar upon hissaww Lordazwj, and Allahazwj did not Command himsaww with this regarding Aliasws. So Allahazwj Revealed Quran due to that, so Heazwj Said: “The Wilayah of Aliasws [69:43] It is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds [69:44] And if he had fabricated against Us some of the sayings, [69:45] We would certainly have seized him by the right hand, [69:46] Then We would certainly have cut off his aorta (vein). Then the Speech turned, so Heazwj Said [69:48] And it, the Wilayah of Aliasws, is a Reminder for the pious. [69:49] And We know that some of you are beliers. [69:50] And it the Wilayah of Aliasws is a regret to the unbelievers. [69:51] And most surely it, the Wilayah, is the true certainty [69:52] So Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Magnificent. Heazwj is Saying that you should thank your Lordazwj the Magnificent Who Gave you this Grace’. I said, ‘[72:13] And that when we heard the guidance, we believed in it’. Heasws said: ‘The Guidance is the Wilayah. So whoever believes in the Wilayah of his Lord, he should neither fear loss nor Punishment’. I said, ‘Revelation?’ Heasws said: ‘(sure) without Explanation’. I said, ‘Hisazwj Words [72:21] Say: I do not control for you evil or good’. Heasws said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww called the people to the Wilayah of Aliasws. So the Qureysh gathered to himsaww and they said, ‘O Muhammadsaww! Excuse us from this!’ So Rasool-Allahsaww said to them: ‘This is to Allahazwj, it isn’t to mesaww’. So they accused himsaww and exited from hissaww presence. Thus, Allahazwj Revealed [72:21] Say: I do not control for you evil or good [72:22] Say: Surely no one can protect me against Allah, nor can I find besides Him any place of refuge: [72:23] It is a Preaching from Allah and His Message regarding Aliasws’. I said, ‘This is Revelation?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’. Then heasws said: ‘An emphasis - and whoever disobeys Allah and His Rasool regarding the Wilayah of Aliasws surely he shall have the fire of Hell to abide therein for ever’. I said, ‘[72:24] Until when they see what they are threatened with, then shall they know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number. (Heasws said): ‘It Means by that Al-Qaimasws and hisasws helpers’. I said, ‘[73:10] And bear patiently at what they are saying’. Heasws said: ‘(What) they are saying regarding yousaww and avoid them with a becoming avoidance. [73:11] And leave to Me, O Muhammadsaww, the beliers of your successor, the possessors of ease and plenty, and respite them a little’. I said, ‘This is Revelation?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘[74:31] that those who have been Given the Book may be certain’. Heasws said: ‘That they would become convinced that Allahazwj and Hisazwj Rasoolsaww and hissaww successorasws are true’. I said, ‘and those who believe may increase in faith’. Heasws said: ‘And they would be increased in faith of the Wilayah of the successorasws’. I said, ‘and those who have been Given the Book and the believers may not doubt’. Heasws said: ‘In the Wilayah of Aliasws’. I said, ‘What is this doubt?’ Heasws said: ‘It Means by that the People of the Book and the Momineen whom Allahazwj Mentioned, so Heazwj Said: “And they shall not be doubting regarding the Wilayah”. I said, ‘and this is naught but a reminder to the humans’. Heasws said: ‘Yes, the Wilayah of Aliasws’. I said, ‘[74:35] Surely it is one great’. Heasws: ‘The Wilayah’. I said, ‘[74:37] To him among you who wishes to go forward or remain behind’. Heasws said: ‘The one who goes forward to ourasws wilayah would remain away from ‘Saqar’ (a valley of Hell), but the one who remains behind from usasws, would go towards the Saqar [74:39] Except the people of the right hand’. Heasws said: ‘They, by Allahazwj, are ourasws Shias’. I said, ‘[74:43] They shall say: We were not of those who sent Prayed (Musalleen)’. Heasws said: ‘(They are saying), ‘We did not (have) the Wilayah of the successorasws of Muhammadsaww and the successorsasws from after himasws, nor did we send Salawat upon themasws’. I said, ‘[74:49] What is then the matter with them, that they turn away from the admonition?’ Heasws said: ‘(Turning away) from the Wilayah ‘. I said, ‘[74:54] Nay! it is surely a admonition’. Heasws said: ‘The Wilayah’. I said, ‘Hisazwj Words [76:7] They fulfil vows’. Heasws said: ‘Fulfilling the vows which Allahazwj Took upon them regarding the Covenant, of ourasws Wilayah’. I said, ‘[76:23] Surely We Ourselves have Revealed the Quran to you Revealing (it) gradually’. Heasws said: ‘By the Wilayah of Aliasws (to be Revealed) gradually’. I said, ‘This is Revelation?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, that is explanation’. I said, ‘[76:29] Surely this is a Reminder’. Heasws said: ‘The Wilayah’. I said ‘[76:31] He Makes whom He pleases to enter into His Mercy’. Heasws said: ‘Into ourasws Wilayah, and (as for) the unjust, He has prepared for them a painful Chastisement. Have you not seen that Allahazwj is Saying [2:57] and they were not unjust to Us but they were unjust to themselves? Heasws said: ‘Allahazwj is more Honourable and more Benevolent than that Heazwj should be unjust or link Himself to an injustice, but Allahazwj Mingled usasws with Himselfsaww, so Heazwj Declares the injustice to usasws as being injustice to Himazwj, and ourasws Wilayah as being Hisazwj Wilayah. Then Heazwj Revealed Quran upon Hisazwj Prophetsaww with that, so Heazwj Said [2:57] and they were not unjust to Us but they were unjust to themselves’. I said, ‘This is Revelation?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘[77:15] Woe on that day to the beliers’. Heasws said: ‘Heazwj is Saying: “O Muhammadsaww, Woe be unto the beliers of what Iazwj Revealed unto yousaww from the Wilayah of Aliasws Bin Abu Talibasws. [77:16] Did We not destroy the former ones? [77:17] Then did We follow them up with later ones. The former ones are those who belied the Rasoolsas with regards to obedience of the succesorsas. [77:18] Even thus shall We deal with the guilty. The ones who are guilty to the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww and did from hissaww successorasws what they did’. I said, ‘[77:41] Surely, those who guard (against evil)’. Heasws said: ‘Usasws, by Allahasws, and ourasws Shias. There isn’t anyone upon the Religion of Ibrahimas apart from us, and the rest of the people are away from it’. I said, ‘[78:38] The Day on which the Spirit and the Angels shall stand in ranks; they shall not speak – the Verse’. Heasws said: ‘Weasws, by Allahazwj are he whom the Beneficent Allah permits and who speaks the right thing’. I said, ‘What will youasws be saying when youasws will be speaking?’ Heasws said: ‘Weasws would Praise ourasws Lordazwj, and weasws would send Salawat upon ourasws Prophetsaww, and weasws would intercede for ourasws Shias. So, ourasws Lordazwj will not be Preventing usasws’. I said, ‘[83:7] Nay! most surely the record of the wicked is in the Sijjeen’. Heasws said: ‘They are those who were wicked with regards to the rights of the Imamsasws and they transgressed against themasws’. I said, ‘[83:17] Then shall it be said: This is what you gave the lie to’. Heasws said: ‘Meaning, (belying) Amir Al-Momineenasws’. I said, ‘This is Revelation?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’.
